top_target_buyers.organization: Ashtabula County Department of Job and Family Services
top_target_buyers.rationale: Primary county agency determining eligibility for SNAP, Medicaid, OWF, and childcare assistance. A lite screening tool would directly reduce their intake workload and help residents quickly understand potential eligibility.

contacts.name: Patrick J. Arcaro
contacts.title: Executive Director
contacts.bio: Executive Director since September 2004. Bachelor's in Political Science from Gannon University, Master's in Public Administration with Healthcare Administration Certificate from Cleveland State University. Serves on several local, county and State Boards and Committees.
contacts.notes: Primary decision maker for agency technology and operations. Directly oversees all benefit eligibility programs.

contacts.name: Beverly DeFazio
contacts.title: Social Services Director
contacts.notes: Oversees social services programs including eligibility screening. Key contact for program implementation.

contacts.name: General Information
contacts.title: Agency Main Line
contacts.notes: Main agency contact for general inquiries about partnerships and technology solutions.

top_target_buyers.rationale: Helps residents access assistance programs and achieve self-sufficiency. Eligibility screening tools would streamline their client intake process and help direct clients to appropriate resources faster.
